INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION.title: Crystallization
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION.descrip: You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_MG.desc:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_NB.desc:
Gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_U.title: Crystallization-U
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_U.descr:
Return an Application-Neutron+ from anywhere to your hand and give it [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_NB.title: Application-Nb
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REMINISCENCE_POLLUTION_:
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: When you play a [gold]Crystallization[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: When you play a [gold]Crystallization[/gold], gain {VigorPower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
For every {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Resistances[/gold] you trigger, [gold]Extend[/gold] 1 and draw 1 card.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REMINISCENCE_HARD_CALCI: At the end of your turn, if you Exhausted a card this turn, deal {DamagePerCrystal:diff()}× the number of [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand as damage to ALL enemies.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_QUANTUM_DOT.title: Quantum Dot
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_QUANTUM_DOT.description: The first 2 cards you play each turn trigger both their [gold]Resistance[/gold] and [gold]Reversal[/gold] effects.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_EXTENSION_SPREAD.title: Extension Spread
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_EXTENSION_SPREAD.descri: At the end of your turn, gain 3 [gold]Block[/gold] for each stack of [gold]Extension[/gold] you have.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SHATTER_SONG.title: Shatter Song
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SHATTER_SONG.descriptio: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each.{IfUpgraded:show: Play them instead of Exhausting them.|}
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_U.title: Application-U
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_U.descripti: Add {Cards:diff()} Application-Neutron+ with [gold]Crystallize[/gold] (U) 1 to your hand.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_TILING_FORM.title: Tiling Form
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_TILING_FORM.description:
[gold]Crystallize[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
All [gold]Crystallization[/gold] cards have "While in your hand, you have 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]".
This turn, whenever you play a card, alternately gain 1 [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold]/[gold]Temporary Dexterity[/gold].
Whenever you play an [gold]Extension[/gold] card, this card costs {CostReduction:diff()} less.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_TRANSMUTATION.title: Transmutation
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_TRANSMUTATION.descripti: At the start of your turn, transform a [gold]Crystallization[/gold] into the top card of your draw pile.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REMINISCENCE_PHOSPHORUS: The first time you gain [gold]Extension[/gold] each turn, {IfUpgraded:show:also gain|gain instead} that much energy.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_IN.title: Application-In
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_F.title: Application-F
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_F.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Add a copy of this card into your hand, then [gold]Crystallize[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SPIN_KICK.title: Spin Kick
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SPIN_KICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: It [gold]Retains[/gold] this turn.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SPIN_KICK.selectionScre: Choose a card to put into your hand
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_EXPLOIT_ADVANTAGE.title: Exploit Advantage
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_EXPLOIT_ADVANTAGE.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage to the same target and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_ZN.title: Application-Zn
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_MG.title: Application-Mg
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_PRIMORDIAL_PIERCE.title: Primordial Pierce
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_PRIMORDIAL_PIERCE.descr:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each unique debuff on the target.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SEGREGATION.title: Segregation
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_PRIMED.title: Primed
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_PRIMED.description:
Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
You can only play Attack cards this turn.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_IMIDOGEN.title: Bonding-Imidogen
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_IMIDOGEN.descri:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to {Cards:diff()} [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand. (Plays them instead when upgraded.)
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Temporary Dexterity[/gold].
[gold]Extend[/gold] {Energy:diff()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_IMIDOGEN.select: Choose up to {Amount} Crystallization to exhaust.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_IMIDOGEN.playSe: Choose up to {Amount} Crystallization to play.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_NITRO.title: Bonding-Nitro
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CHARACTERIZATION.title: Characterization
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CHARACTERIZATION.descri:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Next turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTAL_FLOW.title: Crystal Flow
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTAL_FLOW.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: [gold]Replay[/gold] 1. Does not trigger Resistance/Reversal.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SLASH.title: Slash
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_AS.title: Application-As
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTAL_CLUSTER_GUN.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have no [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand, [gold]Crystallize[/gold] {Cards:diff()} and draw 1 card.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SHATTER_CRYSTAL_RAIN.de:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Deal {CrystalDamage:diff()} damage again for each [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Deal the same damage to the other enemies.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_RUST_EDGE.title: Rust Edge
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_ESTER.title: Bonding-Ester
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_ESTER.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Give 1 non-Attack card in your hand [gold]Retain[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: [gold]Extend[/gold] {Energy:diff()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_ESTER.selection: Choose 1 non-Attack card to give Retain.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_HS.title: Application-Hs
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_HS.descript:
ALL enemies lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] (restored at the end of their turn).
[gold]Crystallize[/gold] (Hs) {Cards:diff()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_HS.desc:
While this is in your hand, ALL characters have 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_TH.title: Application-Th
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_TH.descript:
[gold]Crystallize[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
Make an enemy lose {Damage:diff()} HP.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Deal that much damage 2 times.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: [gold]Replay[/gold] 2.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CU.title: Application-Cu
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CU.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
This turn, whenever this enemy takes {DamageThreshold:diff()} attack damage, they gain 2 [gold]Poison[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_ORIGION_STRIKE.title: Origion Strike
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_ORIGION_STRIKE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Your next "Application" card costs 0 this turn.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CONFORMATION_BLOW.title: Conformation Blow
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CONFORMATION_BLOW.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Lose 1 Energy. Deal {ResistanceBonus:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Extension[/gold] you have.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Deal {ReversalBonus:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_THERMOBARIC_FIELD.title: Thermobaric Field
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_THERMOBARIC_FIELD.descr:
Gain [gold]Temporary Strength[/gold] equal to the number of [gold]Crystallization[/gold] cards in your hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GAS_PHASE_SURGE.title: Gas Phase Surge
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GAS_PHASE_SURGE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever you retain this card, its damage increases by {RetainGrowth:diff()} this combat.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Return this to your hand at the start of your turn.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_COLLAPSE.title: Collapse
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_COLLAPSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have at least {ExtensionThreshold:diff()} [gold]Extension[/gold], lose all Extension and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_PB.title: Application-Pb
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_PB.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Transform up to {TransformCount:diff()} Status cards into [gold]Crystallization-Pb[/gold].
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: [gold]Crystallize[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_PB.selectio: Choose up to {Amount} Status cards to transform into Crystallization-Pb.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTALLIZATION_PB.desc:
You may manually play at most 1 Crystallization per turn. Automatic plays do not count.
At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, randomly retain 1 non-Status card.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_H.title: Application-H
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_ANALYZE.title: Analyze
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_ANALYZE.description:
For each unique visible effect you have, gain {PerEffect:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. For each unique visible effect the enemy has, they lose {PerEffect:diff()} HP.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Lose 1 Energy.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CA.title: Application-Ca
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CA.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Lose 1 Energy. Double the next Block you gain from a card.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTAL_COIN.title: Crystal Coin
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CRYSTAL_COIN.descriptio:
Gain {Gold:diff()} Gold.
This card permanently gives 3 less Gold for the rest of this run.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GROUP_MIGRATION.title: Group Migration
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GROUP_MIGRATION.descrip:
[gold]Extension[/gold] {Energy:diff()}.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Play 1 [gold]Crystallization[/gold].
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Put 1 card from your hand on top of your draw pile.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GROUP_MIGRATION.placeOn: Choose 1 card to put on top of your draw pile.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_GROUP_MIGRATION.placeAn: Choose up to {Amount} cards to put on top of your draw pile.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CO.title: Application-Co
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_APPLICATION_CO.descript:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
The first card you draw gains "[gold]Crystallize[/gold] 2" and [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REMINISCENCE_VANADIUM_E:
This turn, whenever you draw a card, draw that many cards at the start of your next turn.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_MACRO_DENDRITE.title: Macro Dendrite
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_MACRO_DENDRITE.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitCount:diff()} times.
[gold]Crystal Resistance[/gold]: [gold]Crystallization[/gold] 1. Increase this card's damage by {DamageGrowth:diff()} this combat.
[gold]Crystal Reversal[/gold]: [gold]Crystallization[/gold] 1. Increase this card's hit count by {HitGrowth:diff()} this combat.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CYCLIZATION.title: Cyclization
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_CYCLIZATION.description:
Exhaust 1 card in your hand.
Draw {Cards:diff()} additional cards next turn.
If the exhausted card is neither a Status nor a Curse, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_SHADOW_CHAIN_BREATH.des:
When drawn, add a copy of this card to your hand.
For each [gold]Shadow Chain Breath[/gold] in your hand, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] once.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REITERATION.title: Reiteration
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_REITERATION.description:
Draw 1 card.
Put a copy of the next card you play this turn on top of your draw pile.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_INVERSION.title: Inversion
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_INVERSION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain 1 [gold]Extension[/gold] for each [gold]Extension[/gold] card you have played this combat.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_NEIGHBORING_GROUP_PARTI:
Draw 1 card.
If it is a Power, draw 2 more cards.
If it is a Skill, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If it is an Attack, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_BONDING_TRIPLE_BOND.des:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Gain {CrystalBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] per [gold]Crystallization[/gold] in your hand.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Gain {ExtensionBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] per [gold]Extend[/gold] stack.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_DEFERRED_RELEASE.title: Aerosol
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_DEFERRED_RELEASE.descri:
Exhaust 1 card in your hand.
At the start of your next turn, automatically play it.
INDIUM_STAR_CARD_DERIVED_APPLICATION_NEU:
Play a random card costing 1 or less from your Discard Pile.
[gold]Resistance[/gold]: Draw 1 card.
[gold]Reversal[/gold]: Discard 1 card.
